definitions.Engineering: Mechanisms, engineering or explicit problem-driven design; merely assembling an object is insufficient.
definitions.Sustainability and Energy: Environmental systems, sustainable materials, adaptation or renewable/clean energy; generic mechanical energy transfer alone is excluded.
definitions.Science: Explicit physical, natural, biological, earth or space science subjects or experiments.
definitions.Interdisciplinary Learning: Explicit links across arts, mathematics, history, culture or social studies and another discipline; not every workshop is automatically classified.

scope: Published grade coverage and editorial relevance only; no booking, fee or duration eligibility implied.
